pet_notes: Approved canonical Chonky Catnap must remain the same identity. Keyboard stays attached to lap or belly every pose. Keyboard faces CAT: spacebar back/top near belly, numpad screen-left, function row front/bottom, teal Escape bottom-right, knob bottom-left of center. Dark charcoal case, white main keys, navy modifiers, teal accents. Approximate Keychron sufficient, no letters. Idle sleepy belly breathing, blinking and head dipping; active running seated paw typing not locomotion; failed slow forehead slump onto keyboard; directional short alternating waddles with attached board; real jumping lift; review squint inspecting, waiting expectant, wave tired paw. Never mirror running-left due keyboard asymmetry. No text, Zs, floating symbols, dust, shadows, extra props or detached effects.
